mapper.select: SELECT id, tech_name AS name, tech_type AS type, tech_price AS price FROM medical_technology WHERE id = #{id} AND active = TRUE
SELECT id, drug_name AS name, drug_format AS format, drug_unit AS unit, drug_price AS price FROM drug_info WHERE id = #{id} AND active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_request (register_id, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark) VALUES (#{registrationId}, #{medicalTechnologyId}, #{requestInfo}, #{bodyPosition}, #{remark})
INSERT INTO inspection_request (register_id, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark) VALUES (#{registrationId}, #{medicalTechnologyId}, #{requestInfo}, #{bodyPosition}, #{remark})
INSERT INTO disposal_request (register_id, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark) VALUES (#{registrationId}, #{medicalTechnologyId}, #{requestInfo}, #{bodyPosition}, #{remark})
INSERT INTO prescription (register_id, drug_id, drug_usage, drug_number) VALUES (#{registrationId}, #{drugId}, #{drugUsage}, #{drugNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT request.id, request.register_id AS registration_id, request.type, request.medical_technology_id, mt.tech_name AS item_name, mt.tech_price AS price, request.request_info, request.body_position, request.remark, request.state, request.created_at FROM ( SELECT id, register_id, 'CHECK' AS type, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark, state, created_at FROM check_request WHERE register_id = #{registrationId} UNION ALL SELECT id, register_id, 'INSPECTION' AS type, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark, state, created_at FROM inspection_request WHERE register_id = #{registrationId} UNION ALL SELECT id, register_id, 'DISPOSAL' AS type, medical_technology_id, request_info, body_position, remark, state, created_at FROM disposal_request WHERE register_id = #{registrationId} ) request JOIN medical_technology mt ON mt.id = request.medical_technology_id ORDER BY request.created_at, request.type, request.id

SELECT p.id, p.register_id AS registration_id, p.drug_id, d.drug_name, d.drug_format, d.drug_unit, d.drug_price AS unit_price, p.drug_usage, p.drug_number, d.drug_price * p.drug_number AS total_amount, p.state, p.created_at FROM prescription p JOIN drug_info d ON d.id = p.drug_id WHERE p.register_id = #{registrationId} ORDER BY p.created_at, p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE check_request SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'CREATED'
UPDATE inspection_request SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'CREATED'
UPDATE disposal_request SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'CREATED'
UPDATE prescription SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND register_id = #{registrationId} AND state = 'CREATED'
UPDATE charge_item SET state = 'VOID' WHERE item_type = #{itemType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND state = 'UNPAID'
